mapper.sql: id, rule_code, name, description, conditions ->> 'applianceTypeCode' AS appliance_type_code, conditions ->> 'conditionCode' AS condition_code, calculation_type, amount, priority, active, version, valid_from, valid_to
mapper.select: SELECT FROM price_rule ORDER BY active DESC, priority DESC, rule_code

INSERT INTO price_rule ( id, rule_code, name, description, conditions, calculation_type, amount, priority, active, valid_from, valid_to, created_by ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{request.ruleCode}, #{request.name}, #{request.description}, jsonb_build_object( 'applianceTypeCode', CAST(#{request.applianceTypeCode} AS text), 'conditionCode', CAST(#{request.conditionCode} AS text) ), #{request.calculationType}, #{request.amount}, #{request.priority}, #{request.active}, #{request.validFrom}, #{request.validTo}, #{actorId} ) RETURNING

UPDATE price_rule SET rule_code = #{request.ruleCode}, name = #{request.name}, description = #{request.description}, conditions = jsonb_build_object( 'applianceTypeCode', CAST(#{request.applianceTypeCode} AS text), 'conditionCode', CAST(#{request.conditionCode} AS text) ), calculation_type = #{request.calculationType}, amount = #{request.amount}, priority = #{request.priority}, active = #{request.active}, valid_from = #{request.validFrom}, valid_to = #{request.validTo}, version = version + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} RETURNING
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_log (id, actor_user_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, after_summary) VALUES ( #{id}, #{actorId}, #{action}, 'QUOTE', #{quoteId}, jsonb_build_object( 'quoteNo', CAST(#{quoteNo} AS text), 'version', CAST(#{version} AS integer), 'totalAmount', CAST(#{total} AS numeric) ) )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM price_rule WHERE active = true AND (valid_from IS NULL OR valid_from <= #{now}) AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to > #{now}) ORDER BY priority DESC, rule_code FOR SHARE

SELECT mr.status, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM quote q WHERE q.move_request_id = mr.id AND q.status = 'ACCEPTED' ) AS quote_accepted, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM reservation r WHERE r.move_request_id = mr.id ) AS has_reservation FROM move_request mr WHERE mr.id = #{requestId} FOR UPDATE OF mr

SELECT appliance_type.code AS appliance_type_code, mi.quantity, COALESCE((mi.installation_conditions ->> 'carryingDistanceMeters')::numeric, 0) AS carrying_distance_meters, COALESCE((mi.installation_conditions ->> 'floorCount')::numeric, 0) AS floor_count, COALESCE((mi.installation_conditions ->> 'additionalPipingMeters')::numeric, 0) AS additional_piping_meters FROM move_item mi JOIN appliance_type ON appliance_type.id = mi.appliance_type_id WHERE mi.move_request_id = #{requestId} ORDER BY mi.created_at, mi.id

SELECT count(*) FROM move_request mr WHERE mr.status IN ('SUBMITTED', 'QUOTED') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM quote accepted WHERE accepted.move_request_id = mr.id AND accepted.status = 'ACCEPTED' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM reservation r WHERE r.move_request_id = mr.id )

SELECT mr.id, mr.request_no, mr.status, customer.name AS customer_name, customer.email AS customer_email, appliance_type.code AS appliance_type_code, appliance_type.name AS appliance_type_name, mr.origin_address, mr.destination_address, mr.desired_start_at, mr.created_at, latest.status AS latest_quote_status, latest.total_amount AS latest_quote_total_amount FROM move_request mr JOIN app_user customer ON customer.id = mr.customer_id JOIN move_item mi ON mi.move_request_id = mr.id JOIN appliance_type ON appliance_type.id = mi.appliance_type_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT q.status, q.total_amount FROM quote q WHERE q.move_request_id = mr.id ORDER BY q.version_no DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest ON true WHERE mr.status IN ('SUBMITTED', 'QUOTED') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM quote accepted WHERE accepted.move_request_id = mr.id AND accepted.status = 'ACCEPTED' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM reservation r WHERE r.move_request_id = mr.id ) ORDER BY mr.created_at, mr.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE quote SET status = 'EXPIRED', updated_at = now() WHERE move_request_id = #{requestId} AND status = 'ISSUED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quote_line ( id, quote_id, line_code, description, quantity, unit_price, line_amount, rule_snapshot ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{quoteId}, #{line.lineCode}, #{line.description}, #{line.quantity}, #{line.unitPrice}, #{line.lineAmount}, jsonb_build_object( 'ruleId', #{line.ruleId}, 'ruleCode', #{line.lineCode}, 'version', #{line.ruleVersion}, 'conditionCode', #{line.conditionCode}, 'calculationType', #{line.calculationType}, 'configuredAmount', #{line.configuredAmount}, 'applianceTypeCode', CAST(#{line.applianceTypeCode} AS text) ) )
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM quote WHERE move_request_id = #{requestId}

SELECT id, quote_no, version_no, status, currency, subtotal_amount, discount_amount, tax_amount, total_amount, issued_at, expires_at FROM quote WHERE id = #{quoteId} AND move_request_id = #{requestId}
SELECT line_code, description, quantity, unit_price, line_amount FROM quote_line WHERE quote_id = #{quoteId} ORDER BY id

SELECT mr.id AS request_id, q.status, q.expires_at, mr.status AS request_status, q.version_no = ( SELECT max(latest.version_no) FROM quote latest WHERE latest.move_request_id = q.move_request_id ) AS is_latest FROM quote q JOIN move_request mr ON mr.id = q.move_request_id WHERE q.id = #{quoteId} AND mr.customer_id = #{customerId} FOR UPDATE OF mr, q
